newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in the after-hours session on Tuesday, as the upside potential was proved to be limited, traders said.
During the day, the spot September contract expired at noon at 128.8 yen per kg, up from 126.2 yen last Friday, with 1,314 lots of deliveries. Volume was thin.

In the after-hours session, prices ranged from 0.9 yen per kg lower to 0.1 firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.1 yen up at 139.4 yen. "Although the spot contract expired firmer, selling on any price rally, pressured the market," said an analyst at one commodity broker.
